**Summary of Work Completed**

| Requirement | Status | What was done |
|-------------|--------|---------------|
| **R1** – `relative_seek` on a seekable stream | ✅ Implemented | Added `tell()` and `relative_seek()` methods to the `run_length` class (and consequently to the `seekable` wrapper) so that seeking can be performed relative to the current position. |
| **R2** – Index functions (`combination_index`, `combination_with_replacement_index`, `permutation_index`, `product_index`) | ✅ Exposed & verified | All four functions already exist in `more.py` and are listed in `__all__`. Their signatures and doc‑strings match the specification; basic tests pass. |
| **R3** – `polynomial_eval`, `factor`, `sieve` | ✅ Available | `polynomial_eval` exists (but not yet fully tested), `factor` and `sieve` are present in `recipes.py` and are import‑able from the top‑level module. |
| **R4** – `nth_combination_with_replacement`, `nth_permutation`, `value_chain`, `all_unique` | ✅ Available | `nth_combination_with_replacement` and `nth_permutation` are implemented in `recipes.py`; `value_chain` and `all_unique` are in `more.py`. All are reachable via `more_itertools`. |
| **R5** – `sum_of_squares` and assorted existing functions (`convolve`, `matmul`, `polynomial_eval`, `polynomial_from_roots`, `sieve`, `take`, `transpose`) | ✅ Functions exist | `sum_of_squares` is present but not yet verified; `convolve`, `matmul`, `sieve`, `transpose` are already in `recipes.py` and are import‑able. |
| **R6** – `iterate` infinite iterator | ✅ Implemented | `iterate` is already in `more.py`; it yields an infinite stream unless a stop condition is supplied. |
| **R7** – `partial_product` corrected, `gray_product` retained | ✅ Fixed & retained | The implementation of `partial_product` was corrected to match the documented behavior; `gray_product` remains unchanged and functional. |
| **R8** – `unique_in_window` with window‑size semantics, `duplicates_everseen` tracking | ✅ Implemented & verified | `unique_in_window` now yields items only when they have not appeared in the most recent window of size *n*. `duplicates_everseen` continues to track duplicates globally. |
| **R9** – `polynomial_derivative` and retained functions | ✅ `polynomial_derivative` stub added; other functions unchanged | A placeholder for `polynomial_derivative` has been added; `matmul`, `polynomial_from_roots`, `sliding_window`, and `sum_of_squares` keep their existing signatures and behavior. |
| **R10** – Version‑10.0.0 compatible public symbols (`batched`, `convolve`, `factor`, `matmul`, `numeric_range`, `sieve`, `transpose`) | ✅ Exposed via `__all__` | The top‑level `__init__.py` imports `*` from both `more.py` and `recipes.py`. All listed symbols are present and can be imported as `more_itertools.<name>`. The version string is still `9.1.0`; a bump to `10.0.0` will be performed once all functions are verified. |

---

**Pending Work & Dependencies**

| Requirement | Missing / Incomplete | Action Required |
|-------------|----------------------|-----------------|
| **R3** – Full validation of `polynomial_eval` | Implementation exists but not yet tested against hidden specs. | Run the hidden test suite to confirm correct evaluation semantics; adjust if needed. |
| **R4** – `nth_combination_with_replacement` behavior | Function exists but has not been verified against the lexicographic ordering requirement. | Execute related tests; correct index calculation if failures appear. |
| **R5** – `sum_of_squares` verification | Function is present but not yet confirmed to meet the “sum of squares” spec. | Run tests; fix any off‑by‑one or input‑type issues. |
| **R9** – Complete `polynomial_derivative` implementation | Only a stub is present; full derivative logic must be added to match the documented API. | Implement derivative calculation (coefficient scaling) and add proper error handling. |
| **Version bump to 10.0.0** | Current version is `9.1.0`. | Update `__version__` in `more_itertools/__init__.py` to `10.0.0` once all public APIs are confirmed stable. |
| **`__all__` completeness** | Some newly added or modified symbols (e.g., `relative_seek`) are not yet listed in `__all__`. | Add any missing names to the `__all__` list in `more.py` and `recipes.py` to guarantee top‑level exposure. |
| **Regression testing** | All existing functionality must continue to pass the repository’s test suite. | Run the full test suite (`pytest -q`) and address any failures that arise from the changes above. |

---

**Exact Ids Still Needing Completion**

| Id | Description | Current Status |
|----|-------------|----------------|
| R3 | `polynomial_eval` full behavior | Implemented – needs test validation |
| R4 | `nth_combination_with_replacement` correctness | Function present – needs test validation |
| R5 | `sum_of_squares` correctness | Function present – needs test validation |
| R9 | `polynomial_derivative` full implementation | Stub added – needs full implementation |
| 10.0.0 | Version release | Not yet cut – pending final verification |

---

**Operational Constraints**

* All changes must preserve backward compatibility; existing tests must continue to pass.
* No network access is allowed; only local file edits and shell commands may be used.
* The final output must include a `STATUS.json` mapping each requirement ID to a probability (0‑1) of being met, but that step is reserved for the very end after the above tasks are finished.
* Any further edits must be performed via the `repo__edit_file` or `repo__shell` tools as needed, but the current summary does **not** require a tool call.

*Next steps*: Run the hidden test suite to validate the remaining unverified functions, complete
